space: dog skin-mesh model space (the frame of public/dog-rig.js REST: +y up, +z chest/front, index 0 = x<0 foreleg); paws are post-torso targets exactly like bomeiR48 action paws (world = model.localToWorld(p))

descriptor_fields.hop: root y offset in world metres (dog baseScale .55)
descriptor_fields.yawOffset: added to the yaw at clip start
descriptor_fields.head: rig.setHead yaw/pitch/roll rad
descriptor_fields.prop: name of the held prop; propPose = model-space centre between the paws + axis
